name: pt9-imperial-primary-in-turn
description: Playtest 9 pbd539 (06:40): Bot Alpha's Imperial 'Score A Public' went stale twice, End Turn was accepted in between, and 3 s later the primary scored and paid in the next player's turn. The primary is part of the strategic action (rules), so (bot pt9-followups): End Turn is refused until every MANDATORY part of the primary is done (StrategyCardResolveKind.MANDATORY: Imperial = score a public + Mecatol point / secret; the turn.action value carries primaryMissing and the web greys End turn with it) (ScFollowGate.endTurnRefusal, every follower already answered here); once the holder's turn is over a primary part is refused (StrategyCardResolveKind.validate: playTurnOver) and Imperial's score list closes (StatusScoreKind.imperialSpent). The bot policy waits on its own primary before End Turn (shim holderPrimaryPending). Base: sc-imperial (pbd28 r1, Yssaril played Imperial without Mecatol Rex). Steps: End Turn refused before the primary; Score A Public; End Turn still refused (secret not drawn); draw the secret; End Turn accepted; a primary press after the turn is refused.
